root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: after incrementing `i` for the copied byte, the destination vector still has spare capacity before the post-loop newline append may execute
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after `++i;` in the copy loop, the line buffer must satisfy `buffer.size() > i` so the later `buffer[i] = '\n';` terminator append stays in-bounds even when the current line fills the initial allocation exactly.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable helper copies bytes into `buffer`, increments `i`, and can reach end-of-file without seeing a line terminator. On that path it must either have already grown the vector or still have spare capacity before the post-loop terminator write. The fixed image satisfies that source predicate by doubling the vector once `i == buffer.size()`, so the same protected newline append executes with `buffer.size() == 32` and `i == 16`.

nodes.state: At the post-loop terminator append, the vulnerable execution reaches `buffer[i] = '\n';` with `i == buffer.size()`, so the write targets the first element past the vector extent.

edges.relation: The loop index `i` produced at the missing-growth site is the same index later used by the post-loop newline write.
